product_one_liner.value: Bitly helps brands and businesses create, manage, and measure links and QR Codes across online and offline channels.
product_one_liner.notes: Bitly describes a link and QR Code management platform for brands and businesses to create, manage, and measure digital interactions across online and offline channels: https://bitly.com/pages/press/bitly-connection-layer-links-qr-codes-2026.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists free and paid plans, including the Core plan and its annual charge: https://bitly.com/pages/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Bitly's customer stories identify Hacking HR and describe Outerthere's use of Bitly. Sources: https://bitly.com/pages/resources/case-studies and https://bitly.com/pages/resources/case-studies/outertheres-path-to-3x-revenue. | named_customers.0: Hacking HR appears in Bitly's customer-story index: https://bitly.com/pages/resources/case-studies. | named_customers.1: The Outerthere case study describes its operational use of Bitly: https://bitly.com/pages/resources/case-studies/outertheres-path-to-3x-revenue.

employee_band.notes: Bitly's company profile lists its company size as 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/552285.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Bitly's company page lists headquarters in New York, NY, and its company profile specifies New York City. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/552285 and https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/52d3b164e4b00c95d6275880/bitly. | hq_country: The company profile corresponding to bitly.com identifies its location as New York City, United States: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/52d3b164e4b00c95d6275880/bitly.

founded_year.notes: Bitly explicitly states that it was founded in 2008: https://bitly.com/pages/press/bitly-connection-layer-links-qr-codes-2026.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog contains multiple engineer-authored technical posts, including Michael Richman's Hadoop-processing optimization article and Sean O'Connor's data-center migration post. The index also contains Peter Herndon's discussion of Bitly engineering and infrastructure. Sources: https://word.bitly.com/post/74069870671/optimizing-text-processing, https://word.bitly.com/post/168053046227/the-great-migration, and https://word.bitly.com/.

public_docs.notes: Bitly has a public developer portal and a multi-endpoint API reference with an OpenAPI specification: https://dev.bitly.com/ and https://dev.bitly.com/api-reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job-board index states that there are no current openings, supporting false under the specified rule. Confidence is reduced because a separate account-executive application remains accessible, indicating inconsistent job-board presentation: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/bitly.

model_provider.notes: Unknown: the reviewed product documentation, AI FAQ, launch article, security materials, and legal/privacy disclosures did not identify the model powering Bitly Assist. The terms say a current subprocessor list is available upon written request. Public AI integrations were not treated as proof of the underlying model. Sources: https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/44440648181005-What-is-Bitly-Assist, https://bitly.com/blog/introducing-bitly-assist-weekly-insights, https://security.bitly.com/, and https://bitly.com/pages/terms-of-service.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center explicitly claims SOC 2 compliance and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a requested compliance category, not as an independently verified certification: https://bitly.com/pages/trust. | compliance_certs.0: Bitly explicitly claims SOC 2 compliance on its Trust Center: https://bitly.com/pages/trust. | compliance_certs.1: Bitly explicitly claims GDPR compliance on its Trust Center: https://bitly.com/pages/trust.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile classifies the July 2017 transaction as Series D. Spectrum describes its economic form as a growth-equity investment acquiring a majority stake, so the stage label follows the funding profile's classification. Sources: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/52d3b164e4b00c95d6275880/bitly and https://www.spectrumequity.com/news/techcrunch-bitly-sells-a-majority-stake-to-spectrum-equity-for-63m. | funding_date: The latest funding record is dated July 12, 2017, and Spectrum's coverage is dated July 2017; the requested month format is therefore 2017-07. Sources: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/52d3b164e4b00c95d6275880/bitly and https://www.spectrumequity.com/news/techcrunch-bitly-sells-a-majority-stake-to-spectrum-equity-for-63m. | funding_amount_usd: The latest recorded round is $63 million. Spectrum Equity's announcement independently describes $63 million in additional funding in exchange for a majority stake: https://www.spectrumequity.com/news/techcrunch-bitly-sells-a-majority-stake-to-spectrum-equity-for-63m. Funding profile: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/52d3b164e4b00c95d6275880/bitly.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent recorded funding is July 2017, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window. Sources: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/52d3b164e4b00c95d6275880/bitly and https://www.spectrumequity.com/news/techcrunch-bitly-sells-a-majority-stake-to-spectrum-equity-for-63m.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Associate Account Executive posting has an application form and no closure notice: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/bitly/jobs/4703185101. This supports true, although the general board simultaneously says there are no current openings, reducing confidence.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 2026 changelog introduces per-link AI-traffic analytics and programmatic creation and management of Bitly Pages through the API and MCP. These are substantive capabilities within May 9–November 9, 2026: https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young's appointment as Chief Technology Officer on March 19, 2026, within the requested November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window: https://bitly.com/pages/press/bitly-appoints-matt-young-as-cto.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Salesforce is an explicit product-integration signal, not proof of Bitly's internal deployment. Qualified and Intercom publish customer stories explicitly describing Bitly's use of their platforms. Sources: https://bitly.com/solutions/integrations/salesforce, https://www.qualified.com/customers/bitly, and https://www.intercom.com/customers/bitly. | crm_stack_signal.0: Bitly publicly offers a Salesforce integration; this is an integration signal rather than confirmed internal CRM deployment: https://bitly.com/solutions/integrations/salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: Qualified's customer case study explicitly says Bitly uses its conversational marketing platform: https://www.qualified.com/customers/bitly. | crm_stack_signal.2: Intercom's customer story explicitly describes Bitly using Intercom: https://www.intercom.com/customers/bitly.
